subject: Post-demo: DPA module choice, controller/processor alignment & VSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@paymentis.com>, Nate Brooks <nate.brooks@paymentis.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: DPA module choice, controller/processor alignment & VSQ kickoff

Hi Elena / Nate —

Thanks again for making time yesterday — great conversation and a clear signal that Paymentis is evaluating Redwood for a payment-fraud detection assistant in your merchant portal. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so we keep momentum.

Key open items we discussed:
- DPA & SCC: you mentioned needing help selecting the SCC module that fits your EU transfers. We generally surface Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) vs Module 3 (Controller-to-Controller with restricted transfers) based on which party controls end-user data.
- Roles: we need confirmation whether Paymentis will be the data controller for end-customer PII in the product flows we’ll serve, or whether Redwood will be acting as a subprocessor for merchant-submitted payloads.
- SOC 2 / HIPAA: you asked for a SOC 2 summary and whether we support HIPAA-covered processing for tokenized PHI fields — see attached SOC2 summary and a short note in the DPA draft.
- VSQ: to speed legal intake, we can kick off a Vendor Security Questionnaire (VSQ); I’ve attached the initial zip and included a link to the HubSpot record for your tracking.

Attachments I’m dropping here for your review: redwood_SOC2-report-2025-summary.pdf (summary), draft_DPA_Paymentis_v1.docx (strawman DPA with SCC module placeholders), SCC-module-decision-matrix.xlsx (a short decision checklist), VSQ-Paymentis-initial.zip (questionnaire + instructions).

Requested next actions / timeline:
1) Paymentis confirms data role (controller vs processor) for the flows Redwood will receive — ideally by end of day Thursday 2026-11-11.
2) Paymentis indicates preferred SCC module (if transfers to EU are in scope) — if unsure, we’ll propose Module 2 as a starting point and legal can iterate.
3) We initiate VSQ (I can push the VSQ to your security contact) — please confirm who on your side should receive it.
4) Redwood legal (cc’d: Rishi, Laura) will prepare a DPA with SCC module prefilled after we get your role confirmation; expect a redline-ready draft within 3 business days after confirmation.

If it helps, I can schedule a short (30m) follow-up with our legal and your security/legal to walk the matrix — propose Wednesday 11/10 or Friday 11/12. Let me know what works.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

On a related note, I flagged HIPAA as a possible requirement for a subset of Paymentis customers. If HIPAA is definitive, we’ll route this to our compliance team for a supplemental BA/processing addendum conversation (it’s a different path than standard GDPR DPA).

From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@paymentis.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Nate Brooks <nate.brooks@paymentis.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: DPA module choice, controller/processor alignment & VSQ kickoff

Thanks Monica — great recap and appreciated the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Controller/processor: Paymentis will be the data controller for end-customer PII collected via our UI and APIs. Redwood would process merchant-submitted payloads on our behalf, so we expect Redwood to sign a processor-style DPA for the merchant flows.
- SCC module: given our model (Paymentis is controller, Redwood will process on Paymentis' behalf and we will sometimes transfer event logs to our EU analytics partner), Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) seems like the right fit. We want legal to confirm but prefer starting with Module 2.
- HIPAA: a subset of our customers (healthcare merchants) do submit de-identified tokens; at this stage we do not expect Redwood to receive plain-text PHI. If that changes, we will flag.

Who should receive the VSQ on our side? Please send it to nate.brooks@paymentis.com (Head of InfoSec) and I’ll loop in our GC once we have a draft DPA.

Happy to do a 30m call Wednesday 11/10 at 10:00am PT — Nate and I can join.

Best,
Elena Suarez
Head of Integrations, Paymentis
elena.suarez@paymentis.com
+1 (212) 555-0147

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@paymentis.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T14:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: DPA module choice, controller/processor alignment & VSQ kickoff

Thanks Monica / Elena — appreciate the quick confirmation. A few legal/compliance notes from our end: 

1) Module recommendation: if Paymentis is confirmed as controller and Redwood is processing on your behalf, Module 2 is appropriate as a baseline. We will prepare the DPA with Module 2 sections enabled and mark Module 3 as out-of-scope unless you flag cross-controller transfers that require a different path.

2) SOC 2: attached summary is the 2025 SOC 2 Type II high-level summary. If Nate requests the full report under NDA, we can provide it via our intake process — please let Nate know to include the intended recipients for the report.

3) HIPAA: based on Elena's note, no plain-text PHI is anticipated. If any PHI-in-scope processing is required, we will need a BA (Business Associate) addendum — not part of the standard DPA.

4) VSQ: Monica, please kick the VSQ to nate.brooks@paymentis.com. The questionnaire includes a short security checklist (networks, encryption, incident response, retention). If Paymentis prefers, we can ingest the answers into our vendor portal and return an initial risk score within 3 business days of receipt.

5) Timeline and deliverables: we will draft the DPA with Module 2 filled and the SCC annex flagged for review within 48 hours after paymentis confirms final role. Legal redlines will flow through Laura (cc'd).

Action items for Paymentis: confirm role (controller) in writing (done — thanks), confirm Module 2 as preferred (please confirm on the call), and Nate to accept VSQ delivery.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

On Thu, Nov 12: we will sync timelines post-call and circulate redline window.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@paymentis.com>, Nate Brooks <nate.brooks@paymentis.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: DPA module choice, controller/processor alignment & VSQ kickoff

Thanks all — quick confirm and next timing following our call this morning: 

- Paymentis confirmed controller role and preference for Module 2 on the call.
- Nate confirmed he will accept the VSQ and expects to receive it by EOD today; I have routed the questionnaire to nate.brooks@paymentis.com.
- Rishi / Laura will circulate a Module-2-first DPA draft by end of day Tuesday 2026-11-10 for Paymentis legal to review.

Next steps on our side:
- Monica to upload VSQ to Paymentis and cc Nate (done).
- Redwood legal (Rishi / Laura) to deliver DPA draft (Module 2 prefilled) by 11/10 COB; Paymentis to provide redlines within 3 business days if possible.
- Follow-up 30m call scheduled: Wednesday 2026-11-10 10:00am PT — calendar invite coming.

Thanks and talk soon —
Monica
